description:
## Why

Foundation for PKIX-lwr9.2/.3/.4 (the actual heuristic implementations). Without offline fixtures, the heuristic beads can't have integration tests that don't require an external limbo.json checkout.

## What

1. Pick ~25 representative testcases from the 47 `bettertls::pathbuilding::*` cases in `~/GIT/x509-limbo/limbo.json`. Distribute across the four failure-mode buckets:
   - cross-signed candidate selection (~6 fixtures from the 22 cases)
   - signature-invalid-at-depth-N (~6 fixtures from the 10 + 10 + 1 cases)
   - pathLenConstraint backtracking (~6 fixtures from the 8 cases)
   - certificate-not-CA at depth (~2 fixtures from the 2 cases)
   - 'no path to a trusted anchor' (~5 fixtures from the 22 cases)
2. Commit fixtures under `pkix-path-builder/tests/fixtures/bettertls/<testcase-id>/` with each testcase as its own subdirectory holding PEM files (chain, anchors, leaf) plus a `testcase.json` summarizing the limbo expected result and provenance.
3. Filename convention: use the limbo testcase ID as the directory name so provenance back to BetterTLS is preserved.
4. Add an integration test harness in `pkix-path-builder/tests/bettertls.rs` that walks the fixture tree, loads each case, runs pkix-path-builder + pkix-path, and asserts against the testcase.json expected result.

## Acceptance

- [ ] ~25 fixtures committed under `pkix-path-builder/tests/fixtures/bettertls/`
- [ ] Test harness loads fixtures offline (no ~/GIT/x509-limbo dependency)
- [ ] Test harness currently FAILS for the cases that PKIX-lwr9.2/.3/.4 will fix — failure is the baseline; passing comes with the heuristic implementations.
- [ ] Documentation in the fixture directory README noting provenance from limbo + BetterTLS

## Out of scope

- Fixing any of the test failures (that's .2/.3/.4)
- Including online::* cases (those are P-384, separate harness limitation tracked under PKIX-wmch)

## Filed by

PKIX-lwr9 decomposition decision 2026-05-11 (Mark).
title: pkix-path-builder: import bettertls fixtures + test scaffolding
